-- T3c (iii): `Elab` has no `Bind`, so no read is chosen from a value.
module Test.ElabScope.Bound (bound) where

import Prelude
import Features.Check.Generate.Elab (readType, seal)
import Features.Check.Generate.Gen (fresh)
import Test.ElabScope.Common (header, minted, site)

bound = seal header (map chained (fresh minted))
  where
  chained handle = readType site handle >>= again handle
  again handle _ = readType site handle
